pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark brown polygonal regions with rounded vertices. Edge gradients are softened by pixel-level noise, showing low angularity. Individual dark regions occupy significantly more spatial area than the light interstitial spaces.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light beige pathways forming a primarily tripartite junction topology. Path thickness is narrow and relatively uniform, with slight expansions at nodal intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette visible along the dorsal neck margin against the desaturated background.
